identity.note: The fed's database bio 19159 (fWo) is this record: The same members and the same unit name: fWo's booking 4946 (3 November 2003), paragraph 34, has 'Thomas and Elliot Harper, Brotherly Love', and RPW's own text of 9 November 2003 (booking 2529) bills them 'the fWo's Brotherly Love' out of 'the fWo's Survivor competition' (quoted as the verified reading has it; RPW's text is not in the fWo workshop). The fed's own appearance record carries it on 30 cards from 21 May 2003 to 1 March 2004.
